annotations.title: Regex tester, test a regular expression

description: Run a JavaScript regular expression against a text and return every match with its index and capture groups (named groups included). Pattern up to 300 characters, text up to 5,000; patterns with nested quantifiers such as (a+)+ are refused as unsafe, uncharged. Use to check a pattern before using it in code. Example: pattern=(\d{4})-(\d{2}), text=2026-10 and 2027-01. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

flags.description: Flags such as g, i, m, s, u (g is always added)
